name: Flight throttle
definition: lever unit sold apart from a stick or yoke that sets engine power, often with flap or trim levers, in flight games and simulators; a stick-and-throttle set (HOTAS) is a flight stick.
notes: Throttle quadrant sold alone, own price and box; PC only; second unit can be linked.

name: Sim cockpit or wheel stand
definition: frame, stand or seat rig made to hold a racing wheel, pedals, shifter or flight controls for play; a gaming chair without controller mounts is B1.
notes: Seat-and-frame cockpit with gearshift mount; wheel and pedal positions adjustable.
